moments.title: Clocks Go Back for Winter
moments.blurb: British Summer Time ends as clocks go back one hour at 2am on Sunday, October 25th, marking the return to Greenwich Mean Time.

angles.name: Extra Hour
angles.copy: Enjoy an extra hour in bed tonight! The clocks go back at 2am, marking the end of British Summer Time. Don't forget to 'fall back'!

angles.name: Darker Evenings
angles.copy: Get ready for darker evenings! The clocks go back an hour at 2am on Sunday. Time to embrace those cosy nights in.

moments.title: Halloween Lands on a Saturday
moments.blurb: Halloween falls on Saturday, October 31st, 2026, making it a prime weekend for spooky celebrations and trick-or-treating.

angles.name: Weekend Spooktacular
angles.copy: Halloween is on a SATURDAY this year! Get your costumes ready for a full day and night of spooky fun on October 31st.

angles.name: Party Planning
angles.copy: A Saturday Halloween means maximum party potential! What are your plans for October 31st? Share your spooky ideas!

moments.title: United Rugby Championship Action
moments.blurb: The United Rugby Championship continues with several key fixtures this weekend and into next week, featuring Welsh and Scottish teams.

angles.name: Welsh Derbies & Action
angles.copy: Big URC weekend! Ospreys face Dragons RFC today, and next Saturday it's Ospreys vs Cardiff. Who are you backing?

angles.name: Glasgow Warriors
angles.copy: Glasgow Warriors are in URC action today against Benetton, then next Friday they host the Lions. Massive games!

moments.title: Plymouth Argyle Away Day
moments.blurb: Plymouth Argyle travel to face Cambridge United in League One today, Saturday, October 24th.

angles.name: Argyle on the Road
angles.copy: It's an away day for Plymouth Argyle today as they take on Cambridge United in League One. Good luck, Green Army!

angles.name: Match Day Build-Up
angles.copy: Match day! Plymouth Argyle face Cambridge United. How are you feeling ahead of kick-off?

moments.title: FA Cup First Round Proper Approaches
moments.blurb: The Emirates FA Cup First Round Proper, where League One and Two teams join non-league qualifiers, is scheduled for Saturday, November 7th.

angles.name: Magic of the Cup
angles.copy: The magic of the FA Cup is almost here! The First Round Proper kicks off on November 7th. Who are you hoping for in the draw?

angles.name: Lower League Dreams
angles.copy: Non-league sides get their shot at the big boys in the FA Cup First Round Proper on November 7th. What's your favourite upset memory?

moments.title: Duran Duran at The O2
moments.blurb: New Wave legends Duran Duran bring their iconic sound to The O2 Arena in London on Halloween night, Saturday, October 31st.

angles.name: Halloween Night Fever
angles.copy: Rio! Hungry Like The Wolf! Duran Duran are playing The O2 this Halloween. What a way to spend October 31st!

angles.name: 80s Icons Live
angles.copy: Simon Le Bon and co. are in London for a massive show at The O2 on Halloween. Expect all the hits from the New Wave pioneers!

moments.title: The Strokes Live in Manchester
moments.blurb: Indie rock icons The Strokes are set to play Co-op Live in Manchester on Monday, October 26th.

angles.name: Last Nite in Manchester
angles.copy: Get ready, Manchester! The Strokes are bringing their indie anthems to Co-op Live on Monday. Who's got tickets?

angles.name: Indie Royalty
angles.copy: Julian Casablancas and The Strokes hit Manchester this Monday. A rare chance to see the New York legends live!

moments.title: The Stylistics in Cardiff
moments.blurb: Soul legends The Stylistics perform at the New Theatre Cardiff on Halloween, Saturday, October 31st.

angles.name: Cardiff Soul Night
angles.copy: You Make Me Feel Brand New! The Stylistics are bringing their timeless soul to Cardiff's New Theatre this Halloween. Perfect for a smooth Saturday night.

angles.name: Soulful Halloween
angles.copy: Fancy a soulful Halloween? The legendary Stylistics are in Cardiff on October 31st. Get ready to sing along to all the classics!

moments.title: Happy Birthday Katy Perry
moments.blurb: Pop superstar Katy Perry turns 42 on Sunday, October 25th.

angles.name: Pop Princess Turns 42
angles.copy: Roar! Happy 42nd Birthday to the incredible Katy Perry this Sunday! What's your favourite Katy track?

angles.name: Celebrating Katy
angles.copy: From 'I Kissed A Girl' to 'Firework', Katy Perry has given us so many anthems. She celebrates her 42nd birthday tomorrow!

moments.title: Happy Birthday Simon Le Bon
moments.blurb: Duran Duran frontman Simon Le Bon celebrates his 68th birthday on Tuesday, October 27th.

angles.name: Duran Duran's Voice
angles.copy: Happy 68th Birthday to the one and only Simon Le Bon from Duran Duran this Tuesday! What's your go-to Duran Duran hit?

angles.name: 80s Icon
angles.copy: Celebrating Simon Le Bon's 68th on Tuesday! The voice behind so many 80s classics with Duran Duran. Pure pop royalty.

moments.title: Happy Birthday Larry Mullen Jr.
moments.blurb: U2 drummer Larry Mullen Jr. turns 65 on Halloween, Saturday, October 31st.

angles.name: U2 Drummer Turns 65
angles.copy: Happy 65th Birthday to U2's legendary drummer, Larry Mullen Jr., this Halloween! What's your favourite U2 album?

angles.name: Rock Royalty
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 65th to U2's Larry Mullen Jr. on October 31st! The heartbeat of one of the world's biggest bands.

moments.title: Happy Birthday Lulu
moments.blurb: Scottish pop icon Lulu celebrates her 78th birthday on Tuesday, November 3rd.

angles.name: Scottish Legend
angles.copy: Shout out to the incredible Lulu, who turns 78 this Tuesday! A true Scottish legend. What's your favourite Lulu hit?

angles.name: To Sir With Love
angles.copy: From 'Shout' to 'To Sir With Love', Lulu's career is iconic. Wishing her a very happy 78th birthday on November 3rd!

moments.title: The Party on ITVX
moments.blurb: The new British drama series 'The Party', starring Luke Evans and Sarah Solemani, released all five episodes on ITVX on October 11th.

angles.name: Welsh Filmed Drama
angles.copy: Catch the new drama 'The Party' on ITVX! Starring Luke Evans and filmed in Wales, it's a gripping political thriller.

angles.name: Binge-Worthy TV
angles.copy: Looking for your next binge? All episodes of 'The Party' are streaming on ITVX now. Have you started watching?

moments.title: Wolf Arrives on Acorn TV
moments.blurb: The six-episode thriller series 'Wolf', based on Mo Hayder's Jack Caffery novels, will be available to binge on Acorn TV from Monday, October 26th.

angles.name: New Thriller Alert
angles.copy: Get ready for a new thriller! 'Wolf', the six-episode crime drama, drops all episodes on Acorn TV this Monday. Perfect for a dark autumn night.

angles.name: Binge Watch
angles.copy: Fancy a new series to devour? 'Wolf' is coming to Acorn TV on October 26th – all episodes available to binge!
